description: Complete mapping of skills and MCPs to ALL resources (Tier 1: tools, components, integrations, scripts | Tier 2: playbooks, standards, templates, schemas, utils, examples, installers, docs). This is the single source of truth for resource dependencies and discovery.

CLI/commands/sync.js.description: Sync command needs updating when new resource types are added or registry structures change

CLI/utils/github-fetch.js.description: Fetch utility must be updated when new registries are added

.claude/claude.md.description: Must list all 38 skills with names, descriptions, and locations

.cursorrules.description: Statistics and registry references need updating when counts change

README.md.description: Version and resource statistics must be current

TEMPLATES/cursorrules-ai-rag.md.description: Template should reference current registry statistics

TEMPLATES/cursorrules-existing-project.m.description: Template should reference current registry statistics

TEMPLATES/cursorrules-minimal.md.description: Template should reference current registry statistics

TEMPLATES/cursorrules-quick-test.md.description: Template should reference current registry statistics

TEMPLATES/cursorrules-saas.md.description: Template should reference current registry statistics

INSTALLERS/bootstrap/bootstrap.js.description: Bootstrap installer must handle all 6 resource types

setup-project.sh.description: Setup script displays resource counts in completion message

scripts/analyze-project.sh.description: Analysis script recommends skills and generates START-HERE.md with actionable next steps

scripts/regenerate-relationships.ts.description: Relationship regeneration script must process all registries correctly

INSTALL.md.description: Installation guide must show current resource counts

SETUP.txt.description: Quick reference must show current resource counts

DOCS/QUICK-START.md.description: Quick start guide must reference current version and counts

DOCS/TROUBLESHOOTING.md.description: Troubleshooting guide references CLI and setup processes

SYNC-UPDATE-PLAN.md.description: Planning document - can be archived once updates are complete

usage_notes.purpose: This is the single source of truth for resource dependencies. Skills and MCPs reference this mapping to discover required resources.
usage_notes.validation: CI validates that all referenced resources exist in their respective registries
usage_notes.generation: This file can be regenerated from individual registries using scripts/regenerate-relationships.ts
usage_notes.file_dependencies: The file_dependencies section tracks which files need updating when registries change. This ensures systematic updates and prevents files from falling out of sync.
usage_notes.automation: When registries are updated, check file_dependencies to see which files need updating. Sort by priority (critical > high > medium > low) and update_type.
